support_files.role: active syntax and safe-validator report writer

independent_review.status: unfinished independent review; no semantic certification claimed
independent_review.change_policy: Move the whole directory unchanged; do not modify findings or assert completion.

preconditions: Matching original source-only final gate passes with zero issues.
Coordinator freezes helper changes before the final plan and syntax QA hashes are bound.
The whole original audit is copied unchanged with /bin/cp -a and every copied file hash checked.
Application is restricted to the exact active copied audit and expected active HEAD.
Every script input, support module, import target and independent-review file matches the reviewed inventory and hashes.

transaction.behavior: Stage transformed helper bytes, recheck all inputs, then move/replace helpers and unchanged review directory. Any exception rolls back exact original helper bytes and review location.

methods: Node --check only for every JavaScript helper.
/usr/bin/python3 -I with ast.parse from stdin for every Python helper; no compilation/cache writes.
Actual current read-only spec and structural validators plus visible-file local Git baseline comparison.
No historical writer, read-credit recorder, application module, test or build is executed.

limitations: Preparing a plan does not apply active migration.
Syntax success does not certify semantic correctness of historical authoring tools.
Old and active source-body evidence retains its existing attributed reviews and exclusions.
The independent reviewer remains unfinished; relocation does not alter that status.
